displayName: OCI-API-011: API — Mass Assignment via Parameter Tampering
description:
Detects mass assignment attacks where request parameters include unauthorized fields like role, isAdmin, or status

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: api — mass assignment via parameter tampering

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_api_011", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%api%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%mass%') AND "value" > 0
